items.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
items.snippet: Binance’s own reserve data lists the drained wallets as backing customer balances, leaving its ether backing an estimated 6% short until the exchange replaces what was stolen.
items.note: Негативний тон для ETH за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Binance hack may involve private key ‘misuse,’ not theft: Blockaid CEO
items.snippet: Blockaid’s Ido Ben-Natan suspects attackers manipulated Binance’s transaction-signing infrastructure, drawing parallels with the Bybit hack.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
